title: The Rival Party
text: Another House's hunters are on the same trail, a day ahead. Their camp is still warm, the bones of their supper in the ashes. They have left a mark on a tree for you, and it is not friendly.

options.label: The quickest sets a punishing pace to beat them to the prize.

outcomes.text: You get there first, worn ragged, their mark still in your head.

options.label: Catch them up and join forces; the trail is dangerous enough already.

outcomes.text: They share the trail, the credit and the watch at night.

options.label: The craftiest lays a false trail for them, repaying their mark in kind.

outcomes.text: They go the wrong way, into country you would not send a dog.
